description: Offline dataset tables (Parquet locally, Delta Lake on Spark). Features and hidden labels live in separate tables; a label is joined only as a training target. Money and rates are decimal strings; model-ready floats are derived columns with a _f suffix. The split column comes from fundforge_ml.contracts.split_of(seed_family) and never from row order.

columns.seed_family: string: hashed for the split; whole families are held out
columns.seed_commitment: string: sha256 commitment, never the seed itself
columns.policy_id: string: e.g. passive, S1_balanced, bot:v1, ppo:<model sha256>

columns.available_day: int: last simulated day whose information the row may use; equals day
columns.action: json string: the command sent, or null for wait

columns.label: string: variant | regime_day_<n> | factor_day_<n> | ...
columns.known_at_day: int: first day the truth could be known by a player; null if only at the debrief

labels.rule: Never a model input. Joined only as a target, with an explicit horizon.
